blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: tegenstellingen uitdrukken met but, although, however, despite
oorzaak en gevolg uitdrukken met because, because of, so, that's why
een doel uitdrukken met to, in order to, so that
een tekst ordenen met firstly, then, finally

head: Woord
Voorbeeld
Plek en vorm
rows: It was cold, but we went out.
Although it was cold, we went out.
It was cold. However, we went out.
begin van een nieuwe zin, met komma
Despite the cold, we went out.
I like tea, while my wife prefers coffee.

blocks.title: despite + naamwoord, although + zin
blocks.text: Despite the rain of Despite being tired, maar Although it was raining. Nooit despite it was raining en nooit despite of.

head: Woord
Voorbeeld
Plek en vorm
rows: I stayed at home because I was ill.
I stayed at home because of the rain.
As it was late, we took a taxi.
It was late, so we took a taxi.
I was ill. That's why I didn't come.

blocks.title: omdat ... ben = because I am
blocks.text: Na omdat zet het Nederlands het werkwoord achteraan: omdat ik ziek was. Het Engels houdt de gewone volgorde: because I was ill. Dat geldt na alle verbindingswoorden.

head: Woord
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: I went to the shop to buy milk.
Ik ging naar de winkel om melk te kopen.
We left early in order to avoid the traffic.
We vertrokken vroeg om de files te vermijden.
I'll write it down so that I don't forget.
Ik schrijf het op zodat ik het niet vergeet.
We went out for a walk.

blocks.title: om te = to, niet for to
blocks.text: om melk te kopen = to buy milk. Nooit for to buy of for buying als je een doel bedoelt.

blocks.title: Woorden om een tekst te ordenen

rows: Despite it was raining, we played.
Although it was raining, we played.
Despite of the rain, we played.
I didn't go because the rain.
I didn't go because of the rain.
I went there for to see her.
I went there to see her.
It was late, however we stayed.
It was late. However, we stayed.
Although it was cold, but we swam.
Although it was cold, we swam.
Because I was ill I not came.
Because I was ill, I didn't come.

blocks.text: Vul het juiste verbindingswoord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: ______ it was raining, we went for a walk.
items.full: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.

items.q: ______ the rain, we went for a walk.
items.full: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.

items.q: The flight was cancelled ______ the storm.
items.full: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.

items.q: I was hungry, ______ I made a sandwich.
items.full: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.

items.q: She saved money ______ buy a car.
items.full: She saved money to buy a car.
Speak slowly so that everybody can understand.

items.q: The hotel was nice. ______, the food was terrible.
items.full: The hotel was nice. However, the food was terrible.

items.q: I like summer, ______ my sister prefers winter.
items.full: I like summer, while my sister prefers winter.

items.q: We visited many cities, ______ Rome and Florence.
items.full: We visited many cities, such as Rome and Florence.

items.q: ______ it was late, we took a taxi.
items.full: As it was late, we took a taxi.

items.q: I missed the bus. ______ why I was late.
items.full: I missed the bus. That's why I was late.

items.q: In ______, I think it was a good decision.
items.full: In conclusion, I think it was a good decision.

items.q: Hoewel het koud was, gingen we zwemmen.
items.a: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

items.q: Ik bleef thuis omdat ik ziek was.
items.a: I stayed at home because I was ill.

items.q: Ik ging naar de winkel om brood te kopen.
items.a: I went to the shop to buy bread.

items.q: Ondanks de regen speelden we buiten.
items.a: Despite the rain, we played outside.
